scanNote:
Photo File Section, UNIT 11 varag'i. Bet raqami yo'q (varaq qirqib olinadi).

Sarlavha: 'Sammy the Wonder Horse' (Sammi — mo''jizakor ot).

Ikkita rangli surat va ular yonida QAYDLAR (yelkanli belgilar bilan):

1-SURAT (yuqorida): qiz katta daraxt tagida o'tirib, tizzasida daftar bilan yozib turibdi, qo'lida qalam, jilmayadi. Orqada yashil o'tloqda ot o't o'tlab turibdi. Yonida uchta qayd.

2-SURAT (pastda): qiz o'rta yoshli erkakka (o'qituvchisiga) qog'oz uzatyapti; erkak kursida o'tirgan, qo'lida ham qog'oz bor. Yonida ikkita qayd.

⚠ Qaydlar TO'LIQ GAP EMAS — faqat so'zlar, qiya chiziq (/) bilan ajratilgan. O'quvchi ulardan TO'LIQ GAP tuzadi.

⚠⚠ MUHIM: qaydlar hikoyaning faqat BOShI (1-3) va OXIRI (4-5) ni beradi. O'RTASI YO'Q — otning g'alati ovozi bilan nima bo'lgani, Salli qanday hikoya yozgani ayтilmagan. O'quvchi o'rtasini O'ZI O'YLAB TOPADI.

⚠ Bo'lim boshidan beri unitlar tartibi: 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 5, 6, 8, 8, 11 — ya'ni UNIT 4, 7, 9, 10 uchun varaq YO'Q.

sections.title: Photo File - Unit 11: Sammy the Wonder Horse

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 11 - Use the notes to write the story 'Sammy the Wonder Horse'.
exercises.instructionUz: 11-UNIT — Qaydlardan foydalanib 'Sammy the Wonder Horse' hikoyasini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — QAYDLARDAN HIKOYA TUZISh.

  Ikkita surat va besh qayd berilgan.
  Qaydlar TO'LIQ GAP EMAS — faqat
  so'zlar, qiya chiziq (/) bilan
  ajratilgan.

  Siz ulardan TO'LIQ GAP tuzasiz.


SARLAVHA:

  'Sammy the Wonder Horse'
     = Sammi — mo''jizakor ot

  ⚠ 'the Wonder Horse' — ismdan keyin
  keladigan LAQAB.

  Shu qolip: 'Alexander the Great'
             (Iskandar Zulqarnayn)
             'Ivan the Terrible'
             (Ivan Grozniy)


KITOB BERGAN BESh QAYD:

  1-SURAT (daraxt tagida yozayotgan qiz):

  1) warm summer day/Sally/sit/under/
     big tree/next to/house

  2) she/want/write/story/for/
     competition/in/school magazine

  3) Suddenly/Sally/hear her horse/
     make/strange noise

  2-SURAT (o'qituvchiga qog'oz uzatayotgan
           qiz):

  4) Mr Thomas/her teacher/give/her/
     first prize/for/story competition

  5) Sally/feel/really happy/to be/winner


⚠⚠ ENG MUHIM KUZATUV:

  Qaydlar hikoyaning faqat
     BOShI (1-3) va OXIRI (4-5)
  ni beradi.

  O'RTASI YO'Q!

  Otning g'alati ovozi bilan nima bo'ldi?
  Salli nima haqida hikoya yozdi?
  Nega ot 'mo''jizakor' deb ataladi?

  ⚠ Buni o'quvchi O'ZI O'YLAB TOPADI.
  Vazifaning eng qiziq qismi shu.


TO'LIQ NAMUNA:

──────────────────────────────────
  SAMMY THE WONDER HORSE

  It was a warm summer day. Sally
  was sitting under a big tree next
  to the house.

  She wanted to write a story for a
  competition in the school
  magazine.

  Suddenly, Sally heard her horse
  make a strange noise.

  [O'RTASI - O'ZINGIZ O'YLANG]
  She ran to the field. Sammy was
  standing next to a hole in the
  ground. A little dog was in the
  hole! Sammy was making a noise
  because he wanted to help. Sally
  pulled the dog out and took it
  home. Then she wrote a story
  about her clever horse.

  Mr Thomas, her teacher, gave her
  first prize for the story
  competition.

  Sally felt really happy to be the
  winner.
──────────────────────────────────


TARJIMASI:

  'SAMMI — MO''JIZAKOR OT

   Iliq yoz kuni edi. Salli uy yonidagi
   katta daraxt tagida o'tirar edi.

   U maktab jurnalidagi tanlov uchun
   hikoya yozmoqchi edi.

   To'satdan Salli otining g'alati ovoz
   chiqarayotganini eshitdi.

   [O'rtasi] U dalaga yugurdi. Sammi
   yerdagi chuqur yonida turardi.
   Chuqurda kichkina it bor edi! Sammi
   yordam bermoqchi bo'lgani uchun ovoz
   chiqarayotgan edi. Salli itni tortib
   chiqardi va uyga olib ketdi. Keyin u
   aqlli oti haqida hikoya yozdi.

   Janob Tomas, uning o'qituvchisi, unga
   hikoya tanlovi uchun birinchi o'rin
   sovrinini berdi.

   Salli g'olib bo'lganidan juda xursand
   bo'ldi.'


⚠ QAYDDAN GAPGA — NIMA QO'ShILADI:

  Qayd:
     'warm summer day/Sally/sit/under/
      big tree'

  Gap:
     'IT WAS A warm summer day. Sally
      WAS SITTING under A big tree.'

  ⚠ QO'ShILGANLAR:
     • ARTIKLLAR — a, an, the
     • FE'L ZAMONI — sit → was sitting
     • BOG'LOVChILAR — and, but, because
     • 'It was...' qolipi
     • BOSh HARF va NUQTA


⚠ HIKOYA O'TGAN ZAMONDA YOZILADI:

  ⚠ TARTIBSIZ FE'LLAR (bu betda):

     sit   → SAT / was SITTING
     hear  → HEARD
     give  → GAVE
     feel  → FELT
     write → WROTE
     run   → RAN
     take  → TOOK

  ⚠ TO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
     want  → wantED
     pull  → pullED

  ⚠ Barcha shakllar 116-betdagi
  Irregular Verbs jadvalida bor.


⚠ PAST SIMPLE va PAST CONTINUOUS:

  'Sally WAS SITTING under a tree'
     → UZOQ DAVOM ETGAN holat (fon)

  'Suddenly she HEARD a noise'
     → BIRDANIGA bo'lgan hodisa

  ⚠ Qoida:
     FON        → was/were + -ing
     HODISA     → Past Simple

  ⚠ 'Suddenly' so'zi HAR DOIM Past Simple
  bilan keladi.


⚠ 'HEAR SB DO' — 'TO' YO'Q!

     'She heard her horse MAKE a noise.'
        ✓ ('to make' EMAS)

  Shu qolipdagi fe'llar:
     hear sb DO   — eshitmoq
     see sb DO    — ko'rmoq
     watch sb DO  — kuzatmoq
     make sb DO   — majburlamoq
     let sb DO    — ruxsat bermoq


⚠ VERGULLI IZOH:

  'Mr Thomas, HER TEACHER, gave her...'

  Ikki vergul orasidagi qism — IZOH
  (kim ekanini tushuntiradi).

  ⚠ Ikkala vergul ham KERAK.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a wonder     = mo''jiza
  wonderful    = ajoyib
  a competition = tanlov
  a prize      = sovrin
  first prize  = birinchi o'rin sovrini
  a winner     = g'olib
  to win       = yutmoq
  a noise      = ovoz, shovqin
  strange      = g'alati
  suddenly     = to'satdan
  a magazine   = jurnal
  a field      = dala
  a hole       = chuqur, teshik

points.en: QAYD:  warm summer day/Sally/sit/under/big tree/next to/house   →   It was a warm summer day. Sally was sitting under a big tree next to the house.
points.uz: Iliq yoz kuni edi. Salli uy yonidagi katta daraxt tagida o'tirar edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ QO'SHILGANLAR: 'It was A', 'a big tree',
'the house' — ARTIKLLAR.

⚠ 'sit' → 'WAS SITTING' — davom etgan
harakat, hikoyaning FONI.

⚠ 'next to' = yonida.

points.en: QAYD:  she/want/write/story/for/competition/in/school magazine   →   She wanted to write a story for a competition in the school magazine.
points.uz: U maktab jurnalidagi tanlov uchun hikoya yozmoqchi edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'want' TO'G'RI fe'l: 'wantED'.

⚠ 'want' dan keyin 'TO' + fe'l:
'wanted TO WRITE' ('wanted write' ✗).

'a competition' = tanlov.

points.en: QAYD:  Suddenly/Sally/hear her horse/make/strange noise   →   Suddenly, Sally heard her horse make a strange noise.
points.uz: To'satdan Salli otining g'alati ovoz chiqarayotganini eshitdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'hear' TARTIBSIZ: 'HEARD'.

⚠⚠ 'hear sb DO' — 'TO' QO'YILMAYDI!
  'heard her horse MAKE'  ✓
  'heard her horse to make' ✗

⚠ 'Suddenly' — Past Simple bilan keladi,
Past Continuous bilan emas.

points.en: [HIKOYANING O'RTASI KITOBDA YO'Q - O'ZINGIZ O'YLAB TOPING]
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ Kitob faqat BOSHI (1-3) va OXIRI (4-5)
ni bergan.

Javobsiz savollar:
  • Otning g'alati ovozi nimadan edi?
  • Salli nima haqida hikoya yozdi?
  • Nega ot 'MO''JIZAKOR' deb ataladi?

⚠ Vazifaning eng qiziq qismi shu —
sarlavha ('Wonder Horse') javobga ishora
beradi: ot QANDAYDIR YAXSHILIK qilgan.

points.en: QAYD:  Mr Thomas/her teacher/give/her/first prize/for/story competition   →   Mr Thomas, her teacher, gave her first prize for the story competition.
points.uz: Janob Tomas, uning o'qituvchisi, unga hikoya tanlovi uchun birinchi o'rin sovrinini berdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'give' TARTIBSIZ: 'GAVE'.

⚠ VERGULLI IZOH: 'Mr Thomas, HER TEACHER,
gave...' — ikki vergul orasidagi qism kim
ekanini tushuntiradi. IKKALA vergul kerak.

⚠ 'first prize' — artiklsiz (barqaror ibora).

points.en: QAYD:  Sally/feel/really happy/to be/winner   →   Sally felt really happy to be the winner.
points.uz: Salli g'olib bo'lganidan juda xursand bo'ldi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'feel' TARTIBSIZ: 'FELT'.

⚠ 'feel happy TO BE' — sifatdan keyin
'to' + fe'l (sabab bildiradi).

'a winner' = g'olib ('win' + '-er').
⚠ 'win' da 'n' IKKILANADI: winNer.
